verdict.rationale: CrewAI's evidence describes developer building blocks: agents, tools with 'data analysis' capabilities, and LLM-analyzed memory, which a developer could use to construct an insights feature. Nothing shows a built-in, in-product feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's own data. Observability and `crewai test` metrics are plain performance metrics, not AI-generated insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
